en: Ah, wh-what are you doing to me...
N-nooooo.....
I am a vampire...
Following my half-lost memories, to London
note: Order moved: 'to London' here, 'I have come.' in #6804.

en: I have come.
To drink the blood of women like you
and so increase my power!!
Oh, what a handsome gentleman.
I'm Sonia. A woman of the streets.
It'd be lovely to have a customer like you.
Where are you off to?
Me, I'm at the park as always.
That's my spot.
Oh, I wanted to see you so much.
I'm glad we can talk like this.
Say, will I see you again?
...At night next time, hmm?
I'm Sonia. I work the streets.
I'll be waiting in the park.
Come and talk to me anytime.
Being approached by a lovely man like you
is quite an honor.
Standing in the park all day long
is pretty hard, you know.
But there's no other way for me.
Oh, just seeing your face
makes me happy.
Even though seeing you won't fill my belly
or make me any less poor.
Who are you?
Sorry, I'm busy right now.
Some other time, please.
I'm busy right now.
Come back some other time.
You came.
I'll put out the light...
Come again, won't you?
I had fun today.
Do come again.
I'm glad you came.
If only we could always meet like this...
I'm Sonia. Hello there, handsome.
What are you doing in a place like this?
I'm waiting for love.
toward me from across the street.
note: Completes #6761 (slice 084): needs #6761 = 'The love I'm looking for will come walking'.

en: Oh, hello, handsome...
Waiting for love.
In this city, more people may prefer a glass
of gin to love.
Not that I'm any different. I adore gin.
You seem so kind. How lovely.
If only my customers were all as kind as you
How long do you mean to keep at this trade?
It's not as if I do this because
I want to...
Well, there's the happiness of drinking
a glass of gin every day, at least...
You must be here on some business, right?
Yes.
When your business is done, will you go
back to your homeland?
I'll miss you.
If I can't see you anymore,
what will I have to look forward to
when I stand out on this street?
Oh, what a handsome young man.
Where are you going?
Standing in the park all day long,
Somehow I feel the blood draining from me.
I have a wound, yet I hardly feel any pain.
Oh dear, I've got bruises
As if I'd been in a fight.
Good day. A pleasure to meet you.
Oh? Good morning. Lovely weather.
Is there something I can do for you?
I thought I might greet a beautiful lady.
Oh my... Thank you.
My name is Winifred.
Pleased to meet you.
